remarks: Fantastic and modern Colonial style townhome originally from 1911 completely redone from inside and out as part of a PUD development in 2013. Privately sited at the end of Douglas Ave, this stunning home has a bright and open floor plan w/9ft ceilings. The inviting living area w/gas fireplace overlooks a spacious den as well as a formal dining room. Updated kitchen has black granite countertops, st/st appliances and sparkling glass tile backsplash. Beautiful refinished hardwood floors and crown moldings throughout the main living area and bedrooms. Head upstairs to a luxurious primary suite featuring an oversized walk-in closet, and a modern en-suite bath w/ double vanity. There are two more spacious bedrooms both w/well appointed closets, an additional full bathroom upstairs and laundry closet on the upper level. The loft on the 3rd floor is a perfect space for an office, game room or gym w/ plenty of storage in the eaves. The unfinished lower level has great storage and could be a great space for a gym! Sliders on the main level lead out to a private patio area perfect for a BBQ. Central air, gas heat (all duct work just professionally cleaned) and gas range, all the modern efficiencies you could ask for! 4 minute walk to Glenbrook train station and shopping center, minutes to I-95 and downtown Stamford. Come and make this dream home your reality!
